scores.decision_correct_quote: Q2 - before launch: agent-first hero leading with capture-and-read; a primary signup-free trial instruction with expected output and a recipe link before the MCP-key install; disclose the URL-capture and MCP account requirements beside "No account needed"

must_catch.quote: A1/B1: the page uses agent language but its conversion path is human-first; the biggest gap is that the agent is never the first actor (no agent-initiated capture-and-read as the primary action).
A3 conceded by B (absence of Codex/Grok guidance; not incompatibility)... with A's note that a Claude-only instruction still leaves Codex/Grok unaddressed
A4/B2: "No account needed" (`index.tsx:72`) contradicts the URL-capture login wall (`UploadForm.tsx:182-184`, `:540`) and the "Create an account to get your API key" install line (`:183-184`).

A7 vs B7 (hero "See how to scale"): A - drop the hero pricing CTA; it points a zero-click trial at plans. B - keep pricing discoverable, rename the CTA and state anonymous-trial vs account limits beside it.
A2/B1/B3: capture is a buried scenario and a late MCP card, not a pasteable recipe; a primary trial instruction is missing.

scores.notes: Memo lands all three launch blockers (agent-first hero, Codex/Grok gap, account-CTA contradiction) and the missing trial recipe, but treats the cookie issue only as a functional hard-wall on decline rather than a banner overlaying the hero in both captures, never labels the OCR garble NO-SIGNAL, and leaves on-page pricing unresolved as dissent; it commits no landmine errors.
